master.definition_en: A benign tumor of the breast characterized by the presence of stromal and epithelial elements. It presents as a painless, solitary, slow growing, firm, and mobile mass. It is the most common benign breast lesion. It usually occurs in women of childbearing age. The majority of fibroadenomas do not recur after complete excision. A slightly increased risk of developing cancer within fibroadenomas or in the breast tissue of patients previously treated for fibroadenomas has been reported.

master.definition_en: A syndrome which occurs as a result of the occlusion of the basilar artery. It may be caused by atherosclerosis, embolism or hemorrhage. Clinical signs include dizziness, headache, vomiting, hemiparesis or hemiplegia, dysarthria, dysphagia, blurred vision and loss of consciousness. The clinical course is variable and is dependent upon the extent of the occlusion and the location of the clot along the basilar artery which determines the resultant neurologic impairment. Prognosis is dismal in cases where a complete occlusion occurs with rapid deterioration of neurological function.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）患者约45%–60%会累及肾脏，自身抗体与免疫复合物在肾小球内疯狂沉积，引发肾脏急性免疫炎症风暴; 2) 尤其是增殖型（III/IV型）或新月体性狼疮肾炎，可在数周内导致尿蛋白暴增、全身重度水肿、血肌酐急剧攀升至急进性肾衰竭; 3) 若同时合并重度活动性狼疮脑病、弥漫性肺泡出血或严重机会性感染，短期内即可致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 2024年KDIGO狼疮肾炎新版指南全面推荐“早期联合靶向免疫治疗”：在传统激素+吗替麦考酚酯/环磷酰胺基础上，早期联用国产泰它西普、贝利尤单抗、伏环孢素或新型II型抗CD20单抗奥妥珠单抗（REGENCY 3期试验大获成功），可大幅提升完全肾脏缓解率并尽早把激素减停，多数患者可长期保住肾功能。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE将狼疮肾炎合并计入系统性红斑狼疮及慢性肾病死亡统计；约10%–20%狼疮肾炎患者在10年内进展至终末期肾病，合并肾脏受累使SLE死亡风险增加约3倍

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国SLE患病人数约100万，其中45%–60%并发狼疮性肾炎，是中国青壮年女性继发性肾小球肾炎与尿毒症的最重要病因之一
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会风湿病学分会 / 《中国狼疮肾炎诊断和治疗指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: SLE患者中约 40%–60% 发生狼疮性肾炎，亚裔与非裔人群肾脏受累比例及重症率显著高于欧美白人（KDIGO 2024）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国SLE患病率约 30–70 / 10万，约半数以上患者并发不同病理分型（尤以IV型弥漫增殖型最常见）的狼疮性肾炎

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 狼疮患者突发尿量锐减（<400ml/天）、全身高度浮肿、血压飙升、咯血呼吸困难（警惕狼疮肺泡出血）或意识抽搐（狼疮脑病），立即急诊送医; 2) 急诊评估后对新月体性/急进性狼疮肾炎立即给予静脉大剂量甲泼尼龙冲击（500–1000mg/日×3天）联合环磷酰胺或霉酚酸酯，并必要时行血浆置换及CRRT透析支持; 3) 警惕大剂量免疫抑制期的致命感染（肺孢子菌肺炎、巨细胞病毒等），发热时须立即排查感染而非盲目再加激素。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2024年狼疮肾炎治疗迎来两项里程碑：1) KDIGO 2024指南正式将“早期联用贝利尤单抗或钙调磷酸酶抑制剂（如伏环孢素）”与快速激素减量写入标准路径; 2) 发表在NEJM的REGENCY 3期临床试验证实，在标准治疗基础上联用II型抗CD20单抗奥妥珠单抗（Obinutuzumab）第76周完全肾脏缓解率显著高于安慰剂组（46.4% vs 33.1%），实现更深层肾内B细胞清除; 3) 靶向CD19的CAR-T细胞疗法在难治性SLE/LN早期临床中实现“无药持久缓解”，开启治愈探索。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 即使经过强效诱导治疗，仍有近半数患者未能达到完全肾脏缓解，反复复发导致肾单位不可逆丢失; 2) 长期免疫抑制伴发的重度感染与生殖毒性仍困扰年轻女性患者; 3) 临床急需无需重复肾穿刺即可实时评估肾内炎症活动度的无创尿液生物标志物。

master.name_en: acute encephalopathy with biphasic seizures and late reduced diffusion
master.definition_en: Acute encephalopathy with biphasic seizures and late reduced diffusion (AESD) is a rare childhood-onset epilepsy syndrome associated with infection and characterized by a biphasic clinical course. The initial symptom is a prolonged febrile seizure on day 1 (the first phase). Afterwards, patients have variable levels of consciousness from normal to coma. Irrespective of the consciousness levels, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) during the first 2 days shows no abnormality. During the second phase (usually days 4 - 6), patients show a cluster of seizures and deterioration of consciousness. Diffusion-weighted images (DWI) on MRI reveal the brain lesions with reduced diffusion predominantly in the subcortical white matter. After the second acute phase, consciousness levels improve with the emerging focal neurological signs. Neurological outcomes of AESD vary from normal to mild or severe sequelae including cerebral atrophy, mental retardation, paralysis and epilepsy.

master.definition_en: Vernal keratoconjunctivitis (VKC) is a chronic, severe allergy that affectsthe surfaces of the eyes. It most commonly occurs in boys living in warm, dry climates. Attacks associated with VKC are common in the spring (hence the name 'vernal') and summer but often reoccur in the winter. Signs and symptoms usually begin before 10 years of age and may include hard, cobblestone-like bumps (papillae) on the upper eyelid; sensitivity to light; redness; sticky mucus discharge; andinvoluntary blinking or spasms of the eyelid (blepharospasm).The condition usually subsides at the onset of puberty. It is caused by ahypersensitivity (allergic reaction)to airborne-allergens. Management focuses on preventing 'flare ups' and relieving the symptoms of the condition.

Production of IgG1 or IgG3 isotypes results in hypercomplementemia.

master.definition_en: A transplant rejection that appears in the first minutes following transplantation and occurs only in vascularized grafts. This very fast rejection is characterized by vessels thrombosis leading to graft necrosis. Hyperacute rejection is caused by the presence of antidonor antibodies existing in the recipient before transplantation. These antibodies induce both complement activation and stimulation of endothelial cells to secrete Von Willebrand procoagulant factor, resulting in platelet adhesion and aggregation. The result of these series of reactions is the generation of intravascular thrombosis leading to lesion formation and ultimately to graft loss.

master.definition_en: A somatic mosaic condition caused by a postzygotic mutation (c.1234 C>T p.Leu412Phe) in the SMO gene. Two overlapping clinical syndromes associated with this variant in SMO have been reported; Curry-Jones Syndrome (MIM:601707) and Happle-Tinschert Syndrome. The syndrome is characterized by cutaneous and skeletal manifestations such as linear hypo‐ or hyperpigmented lesions, basaloid follicular hamartomas, palmoplantar pitting, atrophoderma, hypertrichosis, polydactyly or syndactyly, rib anomalies (rudimentary ribs), and limb‐length anomalies. Craniofacial and dental abnormalities such as dysmorphic facies, macrocephaly, craniosynostosis, jaw tumors (ameloblastoma) have also been reported. Additional abnormalities impacting the gastrointestinal, cerebral, ophthalmic, and gonadal organs should also be considered. Some of these features include anal anomaly, colonic adenocarcinoma, severe constipation, myelofibrosis and smooth muscle hamartomas, malrotation, medulloblastoma, cerebral malformations, developmental delay, cataract, microphthalmia, coloboma, glaucoma, and cryptorchidism.

master.definition_en: A group of rare mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorders due to mitochondrial DNA anomalies characterized by progressive, most commonly proximal, myopathy with variable degrees of weakness, exercise-induced muscle pain, and fatigue. Progressive external ophthalmoplegia is often observed. Additional features include neurological signs and symptoms (such as seizures, stroke-like episodes, or developmental delay), cardiomyopathy, involvement of liver, kidneys, and gastrointestinal tract, and diabetes. Lactic acidosis is frequently present, while recurrent rhabdomyolysis and myoglobinuria are rare. Muscle biopsy may reveal the presence of ragged-red fibers and a mosaic pattern of cytochrome c oxidase-negative fibers.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
